name: teachteamapp-admin
description: TeachTeamApp admin CMS — GraphQL API + dashboard (separate repository)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:admin-frontend && npm run install:admin-backend
scripts.dev:windows: start "Admin Frontend" cmd /c "npm run dev:admin-frontend" && start "Admin Backend" cmd /c "npm run dev:admin-backend"
scripts.dev:unix: npm run dev:admin-frontend & npm run dev:admin-backend
scripts.build: npm run build:admin-frontend && npm run build:admin-backend
scripts.start:windows: start "Admin Frontend" cmd /c "npm run start:admin-frontend" && start "Admin Backend" cmd /c "npm run start:admin-backend"
